# Bill Gaize

> Product manager, full-stack builder, and AI automation operator focused on logistics, delivery operations, B2B workflows, Shopify/e-commerce integrations, and practical AI agents.

Bill Gaize helps teams turn messy operational workflows into clear, automated systems. He combines product management, software development, API integrations, AI agents, and operations experience from logistics/delivery environments.

## What Bill does

- Product management for logistics, delivery, marketplace, and operations-heavy products
- AI workflow automation using agents, Telegram/email/calendar/tracker integrations, and unattended automations
- Shopify and e-commerce integrations, including API integrations, backend workflows, and operational tooling
- Full-stack web development with React, Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript, and MERN-style stacks
- Internal tools, dashboards, workflow systems, and support/escalation processes
- Product strategy, process design, requirements definition, and cross-functional execution
